Product:{\"sku\":\"7100137104\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
An explosive mix of action and mystery, seasoned with black humor and a sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

PUZZLES, MYSTERIES, AND ACTION

Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale—a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious—and downright dangerous—inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

INTERACTIVE ANIMATION

Creepy Tale isn't just a game; it's a haunting story for everyone. Lovingly crafted graphics summon memories of childhood tales—only darker, stranger, and far more twisted. Whether you dive deep into the narrative or just want a creepy little diversion, this game's designed to be enjoyed by the whole family.

A TWISTED TALE YOU WON'T FORGET

Blizzy has always craved adventure—the more dangerous, the better. Becoming a hero and saving the kingdom? That's the stuff of dreams. But a trip to Hell? Now that's a real opportunity to stretch his legs and prove his mettle. An ancient evil trying to break free? Child's play! The young and fearless Blizzy can handle anything!

Your guide through Hell will be Molek, a tiny imp whose greatest joys in life are candy and children. If you're lucky enough to become one of his favorites, you'll get more than just cruel jokes—you might even get some genuinely helpful advice. After all, watching a child sow chaos is the most entertaining pastime Hell has to offer.

FEATURES:
- Befriend hellish denizens of the underworld—and slip away just before they decide you're dinner.
- Tame enchanted butterflies to bring pictures to life.
- Uncover loads of eerie nods to classic fairy tales... and much, much stranger things.
- Take control of Furry: fight off a monstrous spider and escape a poisonous tower.
- Shatter an ancient seal, unleash the darkness within, and try desperately to set things right.
- Play with Adele—a girl with bipolar personality disorder.
- Lose yourself in the handcrafted animation for dozens of bizarre characters.
- And all of this is wrapped up in a haunting soundtrack and professional voice acting that'll creep under your skin.

Creepy Tale is the brainchild of a small but obsessed trio, pouring every ounce of passion and dark creativity into this chilling project. Prepare yourself for a tale as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

Playing the previous Creepy Tale games is not necessary to understand the story of Snow Child.
